title: 2022-09-23 'Revival my dream' event cancellation
source: Officials announced the Global server would skip the 'Revival my dream' event (story, gacha and cards) for containing expressions deemed inappropriate, offering in-game compensation. The decision drew controversy. On Sep 30 officials clarified the commissioned song would still be added and there were no plans to cancel other JP content. (Source: Fandom/Sekaipedia)
